steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Hot-seating: one person sits in character and answers questions from others — reveals backstory, motivation and relationships.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Role on the wall: drawing an outline of a character and filling it with what they think, feel, experience — builds complex character understanding.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Thought tracking: tapping a performer in a freeze-frame to speak their character's inner thoughts — reveals subtext and hidden feelings.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Conscience alley: two lines of people voice opposing advice as a character walks between them — explores moral dilemmas.
